exposure: Prophylactic intravenous tranexamic acid (1g IV TXA) immediately after delivery
Active management of the third stage of labor
cohort: 300 women undergoing low-risk normal vaginal deliveries.
finding: Prophylactic IV TXA with standard uterotonics significantly reduced mean total postpartum blood loss and smaller reductions in haemoglobin and PCV without increasing adverse events or thromboembolic complications in low-risk vaginal deliveries.
